planned_outcome: Land HMS Endeavour: hybrid Luikov inverse combining M9 surface-Dirichlet BC (proven best top BC) with M15 asymmetric-tin bottom BC + alpha(T) oven-spring profile. Tests whether stacking the proven-best BC choice with the additional physics layers identified in M11-M16 finally drops main-bake RMSE below 4 deg C. 5 free parameters: L, D, Lu, q_bottom_eff, alpha_ratio.
actual_outcome: M17 hybrid Luikov Dirichlet+tin+alpha(T) tested. v1 with alpha_pre pinned at molecular value 1.4e-7 gave broken fits (heat propagation 5x too slow). v2 with alpha_pre bumped to effective 1e-6 gave 30K RMSE on early fixtures (still bound-hitting). v3 with alpha_pre fully free gave 10.3K RMSE on BA3C_0946 single fit — better than v1 but worse than M9 Stefan 5.76K. Optimizer found pathological local minimum: L=D=65mm collapsed geometry, q_bottom_eff at lower bound, alpha_pre at upper bound (5e-6). 17 inverse-problem missions across 5 model classes and 6 BC formulations all converge: M9 Stefan 5-11K is the empirical floor; deep-end information limit is structural. Pivoting to Method 1 (parabolic clamp with confidence flag) + Method 4 stub (metadata capture) for production wiring.
success_metric_result: Single-fit validation: RMSE 10.3K vs M9 5.76K (worse). Optimizer converged=False (max_iter hit) with 4/6 params interior. Pathological geometry (L=D=65mm). 6-param Nelder-Mead on 7-zone-loss-surface finds local minima not physically meaningful.

adopt: When 17 inverse-problem experiments across 5 model classes give the same ~6K RMSE floor, that floor is structural — stop adding model complexity
avoid: 6-param Nelder-Mead on Luikov-class problems without strong physical priors finds pathological geometric minima
